answer: Sybil problem: farms mint throwaway keys to vacuum epoch rewards. Mechanism: a new address posts a 14-line sonnet-form commit of 32-byte nonce hashes, then waits a 36h ember cooldown; three oasis benches of two non-kin peers open 4 lines at random and demand the preimage plus a 9s live echo. Cost: 310 POA bonded plus 36h lock, blocking an 8000-key farm. Verification: benches publish the four preimages and signatures; reused nonces or missed echoes fail. Failure: disagreeing benches trigger a fourth retrace in 20 minutes; a failed echo slashes 55% to the benches and freezes the key 3 epochs.
